newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Morocco's RAM airline bids for Air Liberte.
newsitem.headline: Morocco's RAM airline bids for Air Liberte.

text.p: Morocco's state airline Royal Air Maroc (RAM) announced on Monday it had launched a bid with a French group to purchase the insolvent French carrier Air Liberte, a spokesman said.
"Royal Air Maroc and French group Financiere Moncey have presented a bid to Creteil court of justice (Paris), for the purchase of Air Liberte," the spokesman told Reuters by telephone.
Financiere Moncey is a subsidiary of French Groupe Rivaud.
RAM would participate at a level of between 10 to 15 percent, he said, but gave no figures for the size of the bid.

By joining a bid to buy Air Liberte, RAM "wants to ensure its presence in the European air market" which is to complete its liberalisation in 1997 and open prospects for cooperation and development in tourism and air transport sectors, the spokesman said.
Air Liberte owns around a quarter of the slots at Orly, Paris's second largest airport. It lost 650 million francs in the first nine months of 1996 and has 1.5 billion francs of debt.
British Airways Plc on Monday submitted a 25 million franc bid for Air Liberte despite reports that French authorities were unlikely to accept a foreign bid.
